pendingRivalryEvent.title: All-Pro Team
pendingRivalryEvent.description: The All-Pro team is out and you are on the first team. It goes down as one more line in the argument between you and Beau Brennan.

phoneInbox.text: Conditioning test is the first morning. Anybody who fails it runs after practice all week. No exceptions, and that includes you.

choices.label: I'll pass it
choices.reply: I'll pass it coach. Been running all summer

choices.label: Ask for a pass
choices.reply: Coach, any chance I can skip it this year?

phoneInbox.text: I'm holding out of camp for a new deal. Front office wants guys to say something publicly. Got my back?

choices.label: Back him publicly
choices.reply: He's earned it. Pay the man

choices.label: Stay out of it
choices.reply: Love you bro but that's between you and them

choices.label: Side with the front office
choices.reply: We need him here. Business is business

phoneInbox.text: Heat index is 104 out here and the staff wants full pads anyway. You're a leader now. Say something?

choices.label: Speak up for the room
choices.reply: Coach, half pads today. We'll get the work in smarter

choices.label: Strap up and shut up
choices.reply: Pads on. Let's go

phoneInbox.text: Hearing you and the team are far apart on an extension. Care to comment? I'm running it either way.

choices.label: No comment
choices.reply: No comment. Have a good one

choices.label: Nobody is far apart
choices.reply: Nobody is far apart. Write that

choices.label: Say the team is lowballing you
choices.reply: Write that they're lowballing me

phoneInbox.text: New structure for your name and image money. Runs through three states with no income tax. Technically legal. Probably.

choices.label: Keep it clean
choices.reply: Pay what I owe where I earn it. Not risking my name

choices.label: Do the scheme
choices.reply: If it's legal, file it

phoneInbox.text: We'd love you on the pregame show the morning of the game. Ten minutes, fire the city up.

choices.label: Do it, hype the city
choices.reply: I'm in. Let's get this town loud

choices.label: Decline, locked in
choices.reply: Locked in this week. After we win
